name: Codec2
description: codec2 1.2.0 vocoder core, modes 1200 + 700C only. Vendored from drowe67/codec2 @ tag 1.2.0; codebook*.c generated by the upstream cmake build on the host. Host-gated bit-exact against brew codec2 1.2.0 c2dec (both modes, max sample diff 0). codec2_alloc_psram.h (force-included) sends every allocation to PSRAM — the board's internal heap runs at kilobyte margins.
